parsed.answer: This looks like a known problem: PowerToys modules that were set to a given on/off state get switched off or on again by themselves after restarts, updates or sleep. The most similar reports are #46880 (closed as a duplicate of #43449, which is the issue to follow for updates; the maintainers wanted to look at it after 0.99) and #46165. No fix is confirmed in those tickets. Things the tickets suggest: (1) Update to the latest PowerToys. In #23111 the problem stopped after updating to 0.72, though that was an older case. (2) Check whether Windows Administrator Protection is turned on. In #46165 a commenter said it caused the same symptom for them. Also try running PowerToys without admin rights, and see whether the behaviour changes. (3) Keep the bug report ZIP you attached and add your details to #43449, so the team can investigate. Until a fix lands, you may need to re-disable the modules you don't use after updates or restarts.
